text_block_list.text:
The day of the Yayoi Sho. Yet, Agnes 
Tachyon was deep in thought about her 
research, just like always.

Seeing that, the Trainer couldn't help but 
worry whether she would actually run 
properly.

However, stating that she wouldn't let her 
guard down in an important race leading up 
to the Satsuki Sho, she left the waiting 
room.
